solution.what: Located Tomokiyo's 16 September 2026 publication of Biermann and Lasry's 2023 solution and verified its opening and key against the manuscript.

Compared key to manuscript and attempted numeric-label alignment and language-model solving. French 5-gram homophonic annealing (48 restarts x 10M) and English passes gave nonsense; no label-to-glyph concordance could be fixed from the short published opening.
Full texts listed in outcome.texts (George Lasry's request of 22 Oct 2026): linked Tomokiyo's numeric transcription and his solution page by URL

Reading audit, per-document pass (George Lasry's sentence test): the folder holds the numeric ciphertext and the one-clause opening Tomokiyo published; the full plaintext is unpublished. no50I relabelled decoded, not read (excerpt only); class already solved kept; fraction_read 0.09 marked estimated; the key application noted as a workable gap.

Re-read b37 step 1: DECODE R3839 re-fetched (three images, no attachment or decipherment); Tomokiyo's mary3.htm, glyph key image and numeric transcription re-fetched: still only the opening clause published.

Searched for a placement of Tomokiyo's published opening on his numeric labels (one value per label, word signs, up to 22 nulls; b37_wals_crib.py, b37_wals_crib2.py): none, because his labels merge look-alike glyphs.

Built a label-to-glyph concordance on the f. 138 image line by line with Tomokiyo's glyph key (texts/no50I_concordance.tsv, 58 labels with a value); the published opening comes out exactly; labels 10 (b/k), 35 (null/d), 13 (l/w) merge look-alike glyphs; lines 11-14 only partly checked.

Decoded all 562 tokens (b37_wals_dec.py, texts/no50I_decode.txt) and wrote a partial reading and translation (texts/no50I_reading.md, no50I_en.md): 0.077 clean sentences (en word list), 0.154 on explicit holes; kept decoded, not read.

outcome.method_basis: Biermann and Lasry solved the cipher in 2023 (published by Tomokiyo 16 Sept 2026); this work only located and checked the published opening and key against the manuscript.
outcome.notes: Not a new solve. Published glyph key lacks a numeric-label concordance and leaves some signs unknown. Tracker should be corrected to remove Portugal/French attribution from the distinct L'Abbadia worksheet. Verified opening: "The beirar is domestik servand to the erle of shrevisbvry". fraction_read ~0.09 = share represented by the published ten-word opening (approximate). Identified the enclosure (R3839 f. 138) and separated it from the L'Abbadia material; checked the published opening; no extension. 22 Oct 2026, reading audit: only the opening clause is in the repository; decoded, not read (excerpt). Class already solved kept (Biermann and Lasry 2023).

texts.label: SP 53/11 no. 50I, f. 138 (21 July 1581 enclosure)
texts.summary: The cipher enclosure Walsingham sent to John Somer on 21 July 1581, found in an intercepted letter of Mary, Queen of Scots; its opening reads "The beirar is domestik servand to the erle of shrevisbvry".
texts.note: Re-read 23 Oct 2026 (b37): Tomokiyo's glyph key applied to his numeric transcription through a label-to-glyph concordance checked on the f. 138 image (texts/no50I_concordance.tsv, texts/no50I_decode.txt); the published opening comes out exactly. Partial reading texts/no50I_reading.md: 0.077 clean sentences on the en word list, 0.154 on explicit holes (b17_score.py HOLES=1); 20 labels have no value (seven are the key's own unknown signs) and lines 11-14 are not yet checked glyph by glyph, so most sentences break. Kept decoded, not read; the bearer passage, 'I durst vryte nothing of importance be him' and 'You may sovnd and try him, and be him send me ansver' read.

outcome.fraction_read_source: Share of the 562 tokens represented by the ten-word opening published by Tomokiyo, the only plaintext in the repository (approximate). Reading audit, 22 Oct 2026: the document is decoded, not read; the opening is an excerpt.

gaps.detail: seven are unknown in Tomokiyo's published key too; context proposals (58 THE QUEEN, 87 YOUR, 95 THE, 49 OF) not adopted; the Biermann-Lasry plaintext is unpublished (ask Lasry)

gaps.item: no. 50I lines 11-14: concordance not checked glyph by glyph
gaps.detail: lines 1-10 checked 23 Oct 2026 on the DECODE R3839 P3 image; crop the sloping last lines individually (or use a TNA full-resolution image) and finish texts/no50I_concordance.tsv

system.summary: Graphic-sign cipher with letter signs, whole-word signs and nulls (Biermann-Lasry key as published by Tomokiyo).
